epics.title: Active Modules Usability Improvements
epics.jtbd: When I view the active modules on a non-touch device, I want to see explicit scroll indicators, so that I know there is more content available horizontally.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase discoverability of hidden horizontal content by reducing scroll abandonment by 100%
requirements: R1: Add explicit visual scroll indicators (e.g., arrows or scrollbar) to the horizontal scroll region for active modules on non-touch devices.

slices.title: Implement explicit scroll indicators for active modules
slices.jtbd: When implementing the scroll indicators for this epic, I want to provide visual cues for horizontal scrolling, so that non-touch users can discover all active modules.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user views the active modules on a non-touch device,
When the content overflows horizontally,
Then explicit scroll indicators are visible and functional.
Given a user navigates with a keyboard to comply with WCAG 2.1 AA,
When they focus the scroll region,
Then the focus state is clearly visible and they can operate the scroll indicators via keyboard.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero accessibility violations for keyboard operability on the scroll region

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage for authentication components to 100%
requirements: R1: Provide automated test coverage (unit and integration tests) for the authentication logic in AuthController and WebConfig.

slices.title: Add test coverage for authentication logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the tests for this epic, I want to verify the AuthController and WebConfig, so that the authentication logic is demonstrably correct and prevents regressions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the AuthController and WebConfig are implemented,
When the test suite is executed,
Then unit tests must verify pure logic and integration tests must verify the API flows for authentication.
Given an invalid authentication attempt,
When the endpoint is called,
Then the tests must assert that access is rejected correctly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase automated test coverage for AuthController to 100% of public methods

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage for material endpoints and entities to 100%
requirements: R1: Add automated tests (unit and integration) for the modified material endpoints and entities.

slices.title: Add test coverage for material endpoints and entities
slices.jtbd: When implementing the tests for this epic, I want to verify the material endpoints and entities, so that the cataloging functionalities are proven to work correctly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the material endpoints and entities are implemented,
When the test suite is executed,
Then unit tests must cover the entity logic and integration tests must verify the endpoint API flows.
Given an API request to the material endpoints,
When the data is processed,
Then the tests must assert that the responses match the expected schema.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% passing test rate for material endpoints

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% of Docker builds execute the automated test suite
requirements: R1: Execute the automated test suite during the Docker build process by removing the skip-tests flag.

slices.title: Enforce test execution in Docker build
slices.jtbd: When implementing the build changes for this epic, I want to execute tests during the Maven build phase, so that failing tests prevent the creation of a broken Docker image.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a developer triggers a Docker build,
When the Maven package stage runs,
Then the tests must be executed without the '-DskipTests' flag.
Given the test suite contains failing tests,
When the Docker build runs,
Then the build must fail and reject the image creation.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of skipped tests in the build pipeline to zero

epics.title: Automated Code Review Integrity
epics.jtbd: When an automated code review is performed, I want the system to provide genuine critique and reasoning, so that faked approvals do not compromise code quality.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the occurrence of empty critical reasons in approved review records to zero
requirements: R1: Update the automated code review orchestration to reject any 'approve' verdict that contains an empty 'criticalReason' or fails to list logical concerns.

slices.title: Enforce validation for automated review records
slices.jtbd: When implementing the validation for this epic, I want to enforce checks on the review JSON output, so that approvals missing a critical reason are rejected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an automated code review is generated,
When the verdict is 'approve',
Then a non-empty 'criticalReason' must be provided in the JSON record.
Given a review record with an empty critical reason,
When it is submitted,
Then the validation must fail and reject the faked review.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% rejection rate for faked review approvals missing critical reasons
